After you join

What happens next

Welcome email

We'll send you a welcome note from Rosa within 48 hours with everything you need — the member directory, the calendar link, and what to bring to your first gathering.

First gathering

Pick any upcoming event — you're already on the list. Show up whenever you're ready. Bring a dish if it's a potluck, or just yourself if it's anything else.

Newsletter

Every month you'll get a print-style newsletter with the upcoming calendar, a recipe from a member, and notes from around the neighborhood. Worth the membership alone.
